INSERT INTO email_pending_mailbox_state (message_id, attribute, command_id, desired)
                    SELECT
                        $1,
                        key,
                        $2,
                        value
                    FROM
                        jsonb_each($3)
                    ON CONFLICT (message_id,
                        attribute)
                        DO UPDATE SET
                            command_id = EXCLUDED.command_id,
                            desired = EXCLUDED.desired
